versions.changelog:
Initial release providing adversarial verification for cross-model distillation quality.

- Validates distilled decision rules or student skills using adversarial test cases.
- Outputs rule robustness scores, overall distillation quality, and flags weak rules for retraining.
- Zero external dependencies; pure standard library and fully local execution (--selftest with built-in samples).
- Includes a self-learning module to automatically improve performance and adapt to user preferences over time.
- Memorizes usage patterns, frequent issues, and feedback for continuous self-tuning and smarter outputs.
